inputs.original_text: Nigeria’s democracy is undergoing an alarming and largely underexamined transformation: political parties, once meant to represent people and serve the public, are increasingly becoming exclusive clubs for the wealthy. Developments within the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) ahead of the 2027 general elections make this trend clear.
